android.desc:
Are you actively preparing for interviews by practicing in front of a mirror, quizzing yourself with questions and answers? Imagine a tool that provides you with a wide range of random questions, allowing you to record your responses. You can then carefully review and refine your performance or even share these recordings with friends and family on other social media platforms to gain valuable feedback on your answers. Welcome to a new dimension of interview preparation and self-improvement!

PepTalk is an interview speaking practice app
- Practice your speaking skills for your Student visa / Job interview questions
- Customize your own questions according to your situation
- Improve your answers by listening to your recordings and finding blunders
- Share your recordings with your friends and family and receive feedback

Personalized Features for Members
App Personalization: Personalize the app with your Google account

Generate Question Library: Tailor your question library to match the specific job interview you're preparing for.

Evaluate My Answers: Perfect your responses with our built-in evaluation tool. Practice your answers and receive instant feedback and suggestions to refine your interview technique. Sharpen your communication and impress your future employers.

Generate Cover Letters: Crafting the perfect cover letter just got easier. Our feature generates personalized cover letters aligned with job titles and descriptions. Seamlessly compose professional emails and cover letters, setting yourself apart from the competition.

Prepare smarter, perform better, and secure your dream job with confidence using our Interview Practice app. Your gateway to success starts here.
Download now and unlock the key to mastering interviews!

show_hn.title: Show HN: I build an AI-Powered app for practicing interviews

quotes.text:
While practicing for interviews, my first approach was to stand in front of a mirror, quizzing myself with questions and trying to give my best answers. When I answer some of my questions, I think I gave a better answer than before but when I try to recall it, I cannot answer how I did it earlier.

So, I built Peptalk: Practice Interviews app to actively prepare for interviews which will help in recording answers to the interview questions.

  1. Practice interview recording
  - Practice and capture recordings in the background and evaluate yourself.

  2. AI-Generated Content:
  - Generate interview questions based on user-preferred jobs and descriptions and also answer evaluations by AI

  3. Share / Send for Review:
  - Share the recordings for more constructive feedback.
